title: Evaluating Model Performance Under Worst-case Subpopulations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a worst-case subpopulation performance metric (a dual reformulation of Conditional Value-at-Risk) over single demographic features and complex intersectional groups using the Warfarin Optimal Dosage and ACS Income datasets.

Measuring worst-case subpopulation performance across spatial and geographic attributes, such as US states in the ACS Income dataset and regions/coordinates in the Functional Map of the World (FMoW) satellite imagery dataset.
Assessing worst-case subpopulation performance and out-of-distribution model degradation across different time periods (years of image capture) using the FMoW dataset.
